title: A Jedi Takes Control
front_description: The door behind Anakin and Padmé closes, stranding the two young heroes in the sinister Geonosian stronghold. Next, the walkway in front of them retracts, causing Padmé to slip and finally drop down onto a conveyor that leads directly into the droid factory. In a desperate attempt to reach the fallen Senator, Anakin also jumps down, slashing away at attacking Geonosians in the process.
back_description: Ryan Church's production painting of the Geonosian droid factory.
